rv.q: Flamboyantly fun and fiery flamenco experience
Flamenc Oh!! is a fantastic celebration of flamenco and Andalusian culture in London.

This is light entertainment of the highest quality, with a group of dancers evidently enjoying themselves on stage, which in turn rubs off on the audience’s enjoyment of their suitably flamboyant and colourful performances.
For someone who is after warm-hearted fun, packaged up with some true flamenco talent, there is much to enjoy.

cn.t: Critics praise this flamenco comedy for successfully blending masterful dance with physical humor, delivering a joyous cultural celebration that respects the art form while providing laugh-out-loud entertainment.
